clause_neighbours.template: Change request {doc} (CR {cr} to TS {spec}) targets {release}. For each clause it modifies in {release}, which {release} change requests other than {doc} that modify the same clause have a source-verified {wg} disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give the clause, each document, its disposition, the {wg} meeting, and the CR pack document number.
